label: Gemini
description: Aggregation-first surface: fan out across archives cheaply, then synthesise with per-claim attribution.

descriptions.grep_sources: Streams every archive at once. The right tool for 'which projects do X', not for reading one project closely.
descriptions.compare_projects: Groups related archives so several can be read in one pass, instead of visiting them one at a time.
descriptions.find_similar: Find alternative implementations of the same technique, so a synthesis is not built on one source.
descriptions.read_source: Batch reads are efficient here. Attribute each claim to the archive it came from.

guidance:
Use your context budget to aggregate rather than to go deep on one file. `search_by_game`, `search_by_engine` and `find_similar` fan out cheaply, and `grep_sources` establishes how widely a technique appears across the whole library.

When you synthesise, attribute each claim to the archive it came from and say how many archives agreed. Agreement across independent archives is the strongest signal available here; a single source is an anecdote.
workflow: Fan out with search_by_game / search_by_engine / find_similar.
grep_sources to establish how widely a technique appears.
Batch read the most relevant archives.
Synthesise with per-claim attribution and an agreement count.
